text:
oliver: Postmortem follow-up: need final statuspage text + customer summary + a clear process for providing full RCAs to customers. Legal raised PII/log exposure concerns. Assign owners?

sana: I can draft statuspage copy. Will post a short plain-language draft by 3pm PT.

thu: I'll take the customer-facing summary and email template. Plan: short timeline, impact, mitigation, next steps, and a line about data integrity.

ben: Ops: recurring pattern note 1 token-cache eviction events across 5 incidents last 2 months. We must have a remediation ticket + detection rule. I'll own the remediation ticket.

legal: Legal preference: call public posts a "technical summary". Do NOT include raw request contents, internal IPs, or full stack traces. For full RCAs with logs, require CSM approval + consent form or NDA.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-355 0assigned to @oliver

oliver: Sana, paste status copy here when ready. Thu, can you target end of day tomorrow for customer email? Ben, open remediation ticket and attach detection criteria.

sana: Draft statuspage text:
```
Status: Partial degradation of text-generation API.
Impact: higher latencies and transient errors for a subset of requests between 04:05-04:42 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated. We rolled back the recent deploy and are monitoring.
Next steps: A technical summary will be posted on the status page and a customer-facing summary will be shared by <date>.
```
Any edits?

thu: Add: "Data integrity: no customer data was lost or modified." Also include who to contact (support link).

legal: Suggest substituting "technical summary" everywhere and adding: "For deeper technical reports, customers may request an internal report; access requires CSM coordination and a signed consent/NDA for any logs or traces."

oliver: Decision: public technical summary on the status page + offer full internal RCA on request to affected enterprise customers only. Require CSM confirmation and signed consent/NDA before sharing logs/traces. Owners: sana (status copy), thu (customer summary & consent wording), ben (remediation ticket). Deadlines: status today, customer summary EOD tom, remediation ticket within 48h.

ben: Created INF-4620 "token-cache eviction: guardrails + alerting" 0owner: ben 0ETA: 3w. Acceptance criteria: (1) alert when >3 evictions in 15m, (2) mitigation steps documented in runbook, (3) load test shows eviction rate reduction.

thu: I'll post a one-paragraph customer email + a minimal consent checkbox text by EOD tomorrow. Sample checkbox: "I consent to receive redacted internal logs/traces under a signed consent form/NDA."

cs-bot: CS action: will proactively notify top-affected customers. Tracker created: https://redwood.company/cs/outreach/INC-2026-355

oliver: Let's have an async review tomorrow 10:00am PT for drafts. If no objections I'll push the status wording to staging for legal review. Final action items here: - Statuspage technical summary (sana)  draft today - Customer-facing summary + email template + consent copy (thu)  EOD tomorrow - RCA access playbook & consent wording (thu + legal)  EOD tomorrow - Remediation ticket + detection rule (ben)  created INF-4620 - Proactive outreach list (cs-team)  tracker link above

sana: ack :thumbsup:

thu: ack, will post drafts.

ben: ack, will attach Grafana rule and PR to infra.

oliver: Thanks all. I'll update the incident board and assign the comms card. If legal has edits, please post here.
